content: Our LSTM model was adopted from prior work by Dernoncourt et al BIBREF21 . Whereas the Dernoncourt model jointly classified each sentence in a medical abstract, here we jointly classify each word in the HPI summary. Our model consists of four layers: a token embedding layer, a word contextual representation layer, a label scoring layer, and a label sequence optimization layer (Figure FIGREF9 ).
